# mobius-cli 0.16.48

Includes framework and gateway 0.16.48 with transient transport retries, clearer patch rejection diagnostics, bounded progress updates and shared repetition limits for observable hosted tools. Refreshes compatible dependencies and built-in model defaults.

Protocol 97 is unchanged. Existing saved image 2.5 routes using built-in catalogs must be reselected before startup; Codex image 2.6 acceptance has not been live-verified.
